Title: Cardlist data required for JOL import

Messages.Author: ShanDow
Messages.Body:
Hi Guys,

I've been helping out over at JOL trying to get the code to a point where it can be transferred to another server, maintained, etc.

I've think I've got the card import stuff working but I need data for the new PDF sets.

Seems to require a text format similar to the complete list Ankha posted for me recently.

I'd thought I'd ask if anyone has a text version of the card lists from the PDF sets available for me to try and use as import. Bonus points if they are seperate files as well.

Worse case I make one up manually from the complete list, so no big deal if no-one does.

Messages.Author: Maddog
Messages.Body:
This link below help?:-

www.vekn.net/images/stories/downloads/cardlist.txt

The above list has all cards, not just the up-to-date-expansions.

Text Checklist for all expansions - www.secretlibrary.info/?checklist

If the above is no good maybe contact the person/people who updates the text for Secret Library may be able to help. The database is up to date and they have the last two expansions on there.

Maybe contact via the facebook group:- www.facebook.com/secretlibrary/

Cheers
